semantic_difference: Consumes already-published SQ entries or waits according to flags; the caller publishes SQ tail first. Outside SQPOLL, success counts consumed SQEs; with SQPOLL it generally returns to_submit, not observed poller consumption. Decode the raw usize result with linux.errno.
zig_signature: pub fn io_uring_enter(fd: fd_t, to_submit: u32, min_complete: u32, flags: u32, sig: ?*sigset_t) usize

semantic_difference: Without SQPOLL, returns submitted SQEs rather than completed operations. With SQPOLL, success may be higher/lower, including zero, than requests submitted during this call; inspect tagged CQEs.
Publishes SQEs and requests a completion threshold. Without SQPOLL, result counts submissions; with SQPOLL it has the same non-exact count semantics as submit, never a CQE count.
